<documents>
<document id="travel-notice-v2">
DoˆIˆneedˆaˆtravelˆnotice?ˆNo.ˆYouˆdon'tˆneedˆtoˆtellˆusˆbeforeˆyouˆtravel.ˆWeˆretiredˆtravelˆnoticesˆandˆtheˆTravelˆmodeˆsetting,ˆandˆourˆfraudˆchecksˆnowˆuseˆyourˆlocationˆandˆspendingˆpatternsˆinstead.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆinsteadˆ-ˆKeepˆappˆnotificationsˆon.ˆIfˆweˆseeˆanˆunusualˆpurchase,ˆwe'llˆsendˆaˆfraudˆalertˆthatˆyouˆcanˆconfirmˆwithˆoneˆtap.ˆ-ˆAnswerˆfraudˆalertsˆquickly.ˆIfˆanˆalertˆgoesˆunansweredˆforˆ24ˆhours,ˆtheˆcardˆstaysˆlockedˆuntilˆyouˆcontactˆus.ˆ-ˆCheckˆthatˆInternationalˆpurchasesˆisˆswitchedˆonˆunderˆCards,ˆthenˆControls.ˆ##ˆOldˆtravelˆnoticesˆIfˆyouˆsetˆaˆtravelˆnoticeˆbeforeˆweˆretiredˆtheˆfeature,ˆthere'sˆnothingˆyouˆneedˆtoˆdo.ˆOldˆnoticesˆwereˆdeletedˆandˆdon'tˆaffectˆyourˆcard.ˆ##ˆStillˆworried?ˆAddingˆaˆvirtualˆcardˆtoˆyourˆphone'sˆwalletˆbeforeˆyouˆleaveˆgivesˆyouˆaˆbackupˆifˆyourˆphysicalˆcardˆisˆlostˆorˆdeclined.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="products-credit">
CreditˆcardsˆandˆloansˆTallowbrookˆdoesn'tˆofferˆcreditˆcards,ˆpersonalˆloans,ˆmortgages,ˆautoˆloansˆorˆlinesˆofˆcredit.ˆ##ˆYourˆTallowbrookˆcardˆisˆaˆdebitˆcardˆItˆspendsˆmoneyˆthat'sˆalreadyˆinˆyourˆaccount.ˆItˆdoesn'tˆbuildˆcreditˆhistoryˆandˆdoesn'tˆappearˆonˆyourˆcreditˆreport.ˆ##ˆIsˆCushionˆaˆloan?ˆCushionˆcoversˆsmallˆdebitˆcardˆpurchasesˆonˆPlusˆandˆPremiumˆwithˆnoˆfeesˆorˆinterest.ˆItˆisn'tˆaˆlineˆofˆcredit,ˆisn'tˆreportedˆtoˆcreditˆbureaus,ˆandˆisˆrepaidˆautomaticallyˆfromˆyourˆnextˆdeposit.ˆ##ˆCreditˆchecksˆWeˆdon'tˆrunˆaˆhardˆcreditˆcheckˆwhenˆyouˆopenˆanˆaccount.ˆ##ˆPayingˆaˆloanˆorˆcardˆfromˆanotherˆlenderˆYouˆcanˆpayˆotherˆlendersˆfromˆyourˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆbyˆACH,ˆusingˆyourˆroutingˆandˆaccountˆnumber.ˆ##ˆLookingˆforˆcredit?ˆWeˆcan'tˆrecommendˆlendersˆorˆgiveˆadviceˆaboutˆborrowing.ˆ##ˆCreditˆreportsˆBecauseˆweˆdon'tˆlend,ˆweˆdon'tˆreportˆyourˆaccountˆtoˆcreditˆbureaus.ˆAˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆwon'tˆraiseˆorˆlowerˆyourˆcreditˆscore.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="account-under-review">
AccountˆunderˆreviewˆorˆrestrictedˆSometimesˆweˆneedˆtoˆreviewˆanˆaccount,ˆforˆexampleˆtoˆconfirmˆidentityˆdetails,ˆcheckˆunusualˆactivity,ˆorˆmeetˆlegalˆrequirements.ˆ##ˆWhatˆyouˆcanˆdoˆduringˆaˆreviewˆYouˆcanˆstillˆreceiveˆdeposits.ˆDependingˆonˆtheˆreview,ˆyouˆmayˆnotˆbeˆableˆtoˆsendˆmoney,ˆwithdrawˆcash,ˆuseˆyourˆcardˆorˆorderˆaˆnewˆcard.ˆ##ˆWhatˆyou'llˆseeˆAˆbannerˆinˆtheˆappˆtellsˆyouˆtheˆaccountˆisˆunderˆreviewˆorˆrestricted,ˆandˆwhatˆweˆneedˆfromˆyou,ˆifˆanything.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆitˆtakesˆItˆdependsˆonˆtheˆreason.ˆIfˆweˆneedˆdocuments,ˆsendingˆthemˆquicklyˆisˆtheˆbestˆwayˆtoˆspeedˆthingsˆup.ˆ##ˆCanˆsupportˆhelp?ˆSupportˆcan'tˆliftˆaˆreviewˆorˆrestriction,ˆandˆoftenˆcan'tˆshareˆtheˆreason.ˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆyourˆmessageˆtoˆtheˆVerificationˆteam,ˆwhoˆreplyˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆNegativeˆbalanceˆrestrictionsˆIfˆyourˆaccountˆisˆrestrictedˆbecauseˆofˆaˆnegativeˆbalance,ˆaddingˆmoneyˆliftsˆtheˆrestrictionˆonceˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: What's the best travel rewards credit card?
